description:
Runs a Zooza tool by name. Use it for every Zooza tool that is NOT in your tool list — these exist and work; never send the user to another app because a Zooza tool isn't listed. Call get_tool_schema(name) first for the arguments. Write tools behave exactly as when called directly: the first call previews and returns a token, the second (token + confirmed:true) applies.
Tools reachable this way:
- bookings_add_lead: Add a lead (minimal registration on a lead-collection schedule)
- classes_add_course: Create a new programme (course)
- classes_add_share_link: Create a private registration link for a class
- classes_commit_class: Commit a class (schedule + events)
- classes_list_schedule_patterns: List valid Zooza schedule patterns
- classes_list_share_links: List a class's private registration links
- classes_preview_events: Preview class session dates
- classes_preview_schedule: Preview a class schedule shell
- classes_update_course_settings: Change programme settings (preview, then apply)
- comms_find_messages: Read a client's message history (sent emails, replies, SMS)
- comms_find_replies: Read inbound customer replies and set a reply's state
- comms_list_merge_vars: List Zooza message merge variables
- comms_list_templates: List the company's automated email templates
- explain_data_model: Explain Zooza data model
- labels_mark: Attach or detach a label on a course, schedule, or registration
- negotiate_terminology: Negotiate terminology — build a personalised vocabulary profile
- payments_add_plan: Apply a payment plan to a booking
- payments_find_orders: Find a client's product orders
- payments_send_invoice: Issue an invoice (payment confirmation) for bookings and email it
- sessions_add_summary: Add a session summary
- setup_add_payment_template: Create a payment plan template
- setup_update_course_templates: Set a programme's payment plan templates
- submit_feedback: Submit feedback to engineering
- todos_add: Create an operator to-do item
- todos_mark: Change the status of a to-do item
- trainers_add_helpers: Add additional lecturers to classes and sessions

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, shaped as its get_tool_schema input_schema. Omit when it takes none.

name: call_tool
title: Call any Zooza tool by name
